baselines.vllm_apc: raw order with native vLLM automatic prefix caching
baselines.sglang_radixattention: raw order with native SGLang RadixAttention
baselines.manual_oracle: development-frozen safe family layout without online verification cost
baselines.lmcache_cacheblend: LMCache non-prefix reuse/CacheBlend backend when a compatible runtime completes
baselines.cacheslide: official CacheSlide source when its pinned runtime completes
baselines.contractkv: development-frozen layout plus online same-backend verification and fail-closed fallback

statistics.ttft: request send to first streamed content token
statistics.p99: nearest-rank p99 computed per fresh process; repeat distribution is reported without pooling
statistics.goodput: quality-valid completed future requests meeting TTFT SLO divided by measured batch wall time
statistics.drop_rate: offered future requests without a successful terminal response divided by offered requests
statistics.quality_violation: paired task-score drop greater than 0.03 relative to the same-repeat raw baseline

freeze_rules: No held-out outcome may change the split, family level, layout ladder, output budget, SLO, or acceptance threshold.
The manual oracle consumes the development-frozen family map and is not a held-out hindsight oracle.
External runtime failures are retained as compatibility evidence and are never replaced by modeled performance.
